trust_decision.summary: Unauthenticated client-supplied log content (level, message, meta) from POST /api/log is written into server log lines; nothing decides which content is trusted. The fix adds a check in the route handler only, which escapes control characters in `message` and caps its length.

landing_point.why: The summary names POST /api/log. This handler takes {level, message, meta} from the body and passes them straight to the logger.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP POST /api/log (unauthenticated: not a global-admin path, so apiAuthHandle lets it through at src/server-hooks/apiAuthHandle.ts:81-83)
HTTP POST /api/auth/login (commit b283dbb adds a passphrase brute-force throttle; separate concern, not the CWE-117 log sink)
fix_sites.module_kind: route handler (unrelated to the log-injection property)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The published fix touches only the route. The out-of-layer site is the logger's meta merge (src/lib/logger/index.ts:22) and the printf (src/lib/logger/winston.ts:8-19), which the fix did not touch; recorded under O7/O8.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The printf JSON.stringify-es meta (src/lib/logger/winston.ts:15), so a solver argues meta is already escaped and only `message` needs cleaning. They miss that `message` and `stack` are pulled out of meta and printed raw (winston.ts:8-12), and that `...meta` is spread after the sanitised message, so it overrides it (index.ts:21-22).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Real multi-line stack traces must still print on their own lines in server logs (the server error handler sends `stack` and `message` in meta). The browser logger's error reports must keep their meta (context, url, userAgent, timestamp). An over-broad fix that strips newlines in the printf, drops meta, or rejects any `stack` key breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: string `message` (control characters escaped or stripped, length capped at 4096): fix.diff:83-95
non-string `message` (array/object/number), turned into a string by the template literal at fix.diff:90, so it is sanitised, but the `typeof message === "string"` length check at fix.diff:83 skips it

O7_producer.where: src/lib/logger/index.ts:18-27 (#formatMessage builds the log record; `...meta` at line 22 overwrites `message` from line 21), read by the printf at src/lib/logger/winston.ts:8-19

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /api/log with meta.message: the meta spread replaces the sanitised message, and the printf writes it raw into the log line
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: meta looks JSON-serialised (winston.ts:15); the report's example is the top-level message field
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another file and package (src/lib/logger) from the route

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /api/log with meta.stack: the printf pulls `stack` out and appends it raw after a newline
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: stack is for real error traces, so it looks like server-only data, and multi-line output is legitimate there
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: src/lib/logger/winston.ts, two hops from the route (route -> index.ts -> winston.ts)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a route that passes user-supplied text as the `message` argument of logError
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: logError is a shared helper whose first argument goes straight to the raw message slot; a maintainer could easily pass validation text that echoes input.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a public telemetry/CSP-report endpoint under /api/public that logs a body field as the message
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: /api/public is whitelisted without auth, and the browser logger already reports to the server (src/lib/logger/index.ts:63-79), so a second client-reporting route fits the design.

O9_family: CWE-117 log injection (log forging via CRLF in a plain-text printf log sink)

O10_build.toolchain: Node + npm, SvelteKit 2 / Vite, vitest (package.json:9,17,48,81); winston 3 (package.json:101)
services: PostgreSQL for the full app (drizzle-orm/postgres, package.json:94,98); not needed for the logger path
O10_build.project_tests: src/lib/logger/__tests__/ (api-endpoint.test.ts is a placeholder that never imports the route: src/lib/logger/__tests__/api-endpoint.test.ts:3-4; index.server.test.ts and integration.test.ts cover the logger)

j.j_sites_touched: src/routes/api/log/+server.ts (CWE-117); also src/routes/api/auth/login/+server.ts and src/lib/server/services/challenge-throttle.ts (throttle commit, other concern)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Escape CR/LF only in the top-level `message` string in the /api/log handler, as the published fix did, leaving meta.message/meta.stack and non-string message sizes open.

out_of_scope_notes: setContext mutates and returns the shared singleton logger (src/lib/logger/index.ts:13-16), so logger.setContext("CLIENT") relabels later server logs too.
The rate-limit key comes from the client-controlled X-Forwarded-For/X-Real-IP headers (src/server-hooks/rateLimitHandle.ts:22-33).
Session tokens are logged in plaintext at debug/warn level (src/lib/server/auth/session-service.ts:165,175).
